notes: A new foundation under the app and its web side. Your texts, vault, drafts and settings stay.

changes.text: The app and its web side now share one base, so fixes reach both. Your texts, vault, drafts, filters and settings are kept.
Choose your theme, accent colour and language again, once.
Pair your browser again: Settings › Linked browsers › Pair a browser.
On phones that ask for auto-start (Infinix, Tecno, itel), confirm it again when the app asks.
After an update, What changed shows only the notes of the version now running.
The Messages heading in the menu had no words.
